page.layout: One printed page, title page. Centred block of title lines, then a woodcut ornament, then the imprint at the foot. No margins with text.
page.notes: Woodcut ornament (a vase or urn with foliage and drapery hangings) between "RESPONSIO" and the imprint; no text in it. Stains and show-through from the reverse page are not transcribed. The title lines are set in capitals and roman/italic type as printed; the imprint reads "Scripta mense Aprili / anni 1564." with the date in old-style figures.
